title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
lede: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet lets its agents, called dots, choose products and complete checkout for a user, starting with a limited group of U.S. Pro subscribers.

points: Users store an eligible Visa, Mastercard or American Express card once, then ask a dot to buy.
Each purchase shows the items, total and card for review and is approved with Face ID or a fingerprint.
Payment uses a token in place of card details, so neither the dot nor the merchant sees the card number.
OpenAI says card rewards and dispute protections still apply.
Spending limits and pre-approved categories are planned, and a Commerce Partner Playbook guides retailers.

sections.text: OpenAI is publishing guidance for merchants to accept agent-driven orders while others, such as Amazon, block agents, so commerce sites now face a concrete choice about supporting them.
